title: ButtonTickState
description: What the current fixed step owns of a button-like action: every press and release the input frames sampled since the previous fixed step, plus the held state. Each occurrence is delivered to exactly one fixed step: a frame that runs no fixed step keeps its occurrences for the next one, and a frame that runs several delivers them to the first and none to the others. Every reader of the same step sees the same values; reading takes nothing away from another reader. Read it during a fixed step (`fixedUpdate` of a scene, behavior or system, or `Application.onFixedFrame`); outside one the counts are zero. Occurrences belong to the map that sampled them. They are dropped when that map stops being sampled before a fixed step could take them - its scene pauses or is suspended under a `when` policy that excludes it, the map is detached, or the application stops or skips frames while the document is hidden - so an old press never becomes a delayed action after resume. Opening or closing an InputScope above the map, or rebinding it, keeps what was already sampled.

members.name: active
members.description: Held state as of the latest input frame, the same for every step of a frame.

members.name: pressed
members.description: true when at least one press was delivered to this step.

members.name: released
members.description: true when at least one release was delivered to this step.

members.name: step
members.description: Serial of the fixed step this view describes, identical for every action of the same application within one step; 0 outside a fixed step and before the action's first input frame.

members.name: value
members.description: Aggregate value as of the latest input frame.
